processReference.name: User supplied fox diffusion preview
processReference.role: Texture evolution only; subject remains portfolio cover

aesthetic: Sharp unresolved microstructure progressively becomes coherent material detail; no added defocus or Gaussian blur

authoredCheckpoints.description: Step 0/50, pure achromatic latent prediction noise. Dense sharp tiny irregular black white grey grain, a mixture of clustered speckle and minuscule jagged granular islands. Fully unresolved, NO identifiable scene or objects. R=G=B. No geometric tessellation or colored particles.
authoredCheckpoints.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational / style-transfer.
Asset: ONE full-bleed landscape image, aspect ratio 2196:1184. Not a sheet or comparison. Input 1 is the exact final composition: back-view bob-haired woman in mint dress, lower center, under a dark ivy arch, warm green sunlit foliage right. Keep positions and framing. Input 2 is PROCESS REFERENCE ONLY: the fox diffusion sheet illustrates sharp dense confused microtexture organizing into coherent fine detail. Do not copy fox, snow, sheet, labels or borders.
Make an intermediate decoded diffusion prediction. Every region has crisp, dense, irregular high-frequency microtexture. The uncertainty is in SHAPES AND MEANING, NOT focus. Fragments progressively become coherent hair, leaves, fabric. Do not use Gaussian blur, defocus, bokeh additions, fog, watercolor, painterly smears, polygon mosaics, or a completed photograph under an overlay of static. Microtexture is the scene itself. NO text or watermark.

note: 13 image_gen checkpoints plus the original cover are interpolated offline into 51 fixed artistic states. These are not 50 independent image_gen calls, RF inversion, FLUX inference outputs, or the original image's generation history.
